arxiv-1802-02090.title: Causal Classical Physics in Time Symmetric Quantum Mechanics †
arxiv-1802-02090.creator: Fritz W. Bopp
arxiv-1802-02090.description: Abstract The letter submitted is an executive summary of our previous paper. To solve the Einstein Podolsky Rosen “paradox” the two boundary quantum mechanics is taken as self consistent interpretation of quantum dynamics. The difficulty with this interpretation is to reconcile it with classical physics.

arxiv-2003-02955.title: Automatic Compilation of Resources for Academic Writing and Evaluating with Informal Word Identification and Paraphrasing System
arxiv-2003-02955.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by . We present the first approach to automatically building resources for academic writing. The aim is to build a writing aid system that automatically edits a text so that it better adheres to the academic style of writing.

arxiv-2108-07473.title: High excursion probabilities for Gaussian fields on smooth manifolds.
arxiv-2108-07473.creator: Vladimir I. Piterbarg
arxiv-2108-07473.description: Abstract Abstract: 1 1 footnotetext: Partially funded by RFBR and CNRS, project number 20-51-15001 Gaussian random fields on finite dimensional smooth manifolds whose variances reach their maximum values at smooth submanifolds are considered. Exact asymptotic behaviors of large excursion probabilities have been evaluated.

arxiv-2111-08412.title: Invariant generalized almost complex structures on real flag manifolds
arxiv-2111-08412.creator: Fabricio Valencia and Carlos Varea
arxiv-2111-08412.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fabricio Valencia and Carlos Varea. We characterize those real flag manifolds that can be endowed with invariant generalized almost complex structures. We show that no G ​ M 2 GM_{2} -maximal real flag manifolds admit integrable invariant generalized almost complex structures.

arxiv-2204-01573.title: Low Tree-Rank Bayesian Vector Autoregression Models
arxiv-2204-01573.creator: Leo L Duan, Zeyu Yuwen, George Michailidis, Zhengwu Zhang
arxiv-2204-01573.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Leo L Duan, Zeyu Yuwen, George Michailidis, Zhengwu Zhang. Vector autoregression has been widely used for modeling and analysis of multivariate time series data. In high-dimensional settings, model parameter regularization schemes inducing sparsity yield interpretable models and achieved good forecasting performance. However, in many data applications, such as those in neuroscience, the Granger causality graph estimates from existing vector autoregression methods tend to be quite dense and difficult to interpret, unless one compromises on the goodness-of-fit.

arxiv-2212-00247.title: Phenomenology of Strong Interactions — Towards an Effective Theory for Low Energy QCD
arxiv-2212-00247.creator: Adamu Issifu, Francisco A. Brito
arxiv-2212-00247.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop models applicable to phenomenological particle physics by using the string analogy of particles. These theories can be used to investigate the phenomenology of confinement, deconfinement, chiral condensate, QGP phase transitions, and even the evolution of the early universe.

arxiv-2306-15108.title: Scaling symmetries and canonoid transformations in Hamiltonian systems
arxiv-2306-15108.creator: R. Azuaje, A. Bravetti
arxiv-2306-15108.description: Abstract We investigate various types of symmetries and their mutual relationships in Hamiltonian systems defined on manifolds with different geometric structures: symplectic, cosymplectic, contact and cocontact. In each case we pay special attention to non-standard (non-canonical) symmetries, in particular scaling symmetries and canonoid transformations, as they provide new interesting tools for the qualitative study of these systems.

arxiv-2408-10999.title: Constraining Extra Mixing during the Main Sequence: Whatever Depletes Lithium Does Not Touch Beryllium Facilities: VLT:Kueyen, ESO:3.6m, Gaia
arxiv-2408-10999.creator: Henrique Reggiani, Jhon Yana Galarza, Diego Lorenzo-Oliveira, Sofia Covarrubias, Micaela Oyague, Rita Valle, Julio Chanamé
arxiv-2408-10999.description: Abstract Measurements of lithium abundances in solar-type stars have shown that standard models of stellar evolution are incapable of explaining the observed depletion as a function of stellar age. Beryllium is one of the lightest elements that can be measured in stellar photospheres, and it can be burned in relatively low temperatures.

arxiv-2412-10073.title: Africanus III. pfb-imaging - a flexible radio interferometric imaging suite
arxiv-2412-10073.creator: H. L. Bester, J. S. Kenyon, A. Repetti, S. J. Perkins, O. M. Smirnov, T. Blecher, Y. Mhiri, J. Roth, I. Heywood, Y. Wiaux, B. V. Hugo
arxiv-2412-10073.description: Abstract The popularity of the CLEAN algorithm in radio interferometric imaging stems from its maturity, speed, and robustness. While many alternatives have been proposed in the literature, none have achieved mainstream adoption by astronomers working with data from interferometric arrays operating in the big data regime.

arxiv-2504-04018.title: ESG: Elastic Graphs for Range-Filtering Approximate k k -Nearest Neighbor Search
arxiv-2504-04018.creator: Mingyu Yang 1,2 , Wentao Li 3 , Zhitao Shen 4 , Chuan Xiao 5 , Wei Wang 1,2
arxiv-2504-04018.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mingyu Yang 1,2 , Wentao Li 3 , Zhitao Shen 4 , Chuan Xiao 5 , Wei Wang 1,2. Range-filtering approximate k k -nearest neighbor (RFAKNN) search takes as input a vector and a numeric value, returning k k points from a database of N N high-dimensional points. The returned points must satisfy two criteria: their numeric values must lie within the specified query range, and they must be approximately the k k nearest points to the query vector.

pmc-10510291.title: Family physicians’ questions about the COVID-19 pandemic: a content analysis of 2,272 helpline calls
pmc-10510291.creator: Allan McDougall, Jacqueline H Fortier, Cathy Zhang, Caroline Ehrat, Kerri Best, Heather Blois, Gary Garber
pmc-10510291.description: BackgroundDuring the COVID-19 pandemic, family physicians faced challenges including travel restrictions for patients, lockdowns, diagnostic testing delays, and changing public health guidelines. Given that 95% of Canadian physicians are members of the Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA), the CMPA’s telephone helpline — which offers peer-to-peer support — provides valuable insights into family physicians’ experiences during the pandemic.

pmc-10514066.title: Successful retrosternal esophageal bypass with gastric transposition in the management of esophago-pleural fistula as a complication of Boerhaave syndrome
pmc-10514066.creator: A. Piratheepan, S. Inthujan, V. Sutharshan
pmc-10514066.description: Introduction and importanceBoerhaave syndrome is a rare life-threatening condition that represents about 15 % of esophageal perforation and is associated with significant mortality. A subset of patients with effort rupture of the esophagus can present with esophago-pleural fistula. Management of esophago-pleural fistula remains a challenge due to the lack of high-quality evidence studies and the rarity of reported cases.

pmc-10614373.title: Intracellular remodeling associated with endoplasmic reticulum stress modifies biomechanical compliance of bladder cells
pmc-10614373.creator: Livia Gruber, Maximilian Jobst, Endre Kiss, Martina Karasová, Bernhard Englinger, Walter Berger, Giorgia Del Favero
pmc-10614373.description: Bladder cells face a challenging biophysical environment: mechanical cues originating from urine flow and regular contraction to enable the filling voiding of the organ. To ensure functional adaption, bladder cells rely on high biomechanical compliance, nevertheless aging or chronic pathological conditions can modify this plasticity.

pmc-10706908.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of Gibberellic Acid-Stimulated Arabidopsis Gene Family in Pineapple (Ananas comosus)

pmc-10706908.description: The gibberellic acid-stimulated Arabidopsis (GASA) gene family plays a crucial role in growth, development, and stress response, and it is specific to plants. This gene family has been extensively studied in various plant species, and its functional role in pineapple has yet to be characterized.

pmc-12740966.title: Identification and functional characterization of a novel thioredoxin MpTRX1 from Metschnikowia persimmonesis
pmc-12740966.creator: Chang Ho Kang, Jae Hyeok Lee, Yeong Min Lee, Yong Bok Lee, Youngmin Kang, Yeongjun Ban, Ariranur Haniffadli, Endang Rahmat, Chae Oh Lim
pmc-12740966.description: Thioredoxins (TRXs) are small, conserved redox-active proteins that play central roles in oxidative stress responses. Here, we identified and functionally characterized a novel thioredoxin, MpTRX1, from the newly isolated yeast Metschnikowia persimmonesis. The full-length MpTRX1 gene was cloned and expressed in Escherichia coli and Saccharomyces cerevisiae to analyze its biochemical and physiological functions.

pmc-13100293.title: Simple, rapid and cost-effective DNA extraction techniques for detection of economically important fruit flies in India
pmc-13100293.creator: Suman Barman, Shashank Pathour Rajendra, Damini Diksha, Susheel Kumar Sharma, Nitika Gupta, Godavari Hadpad, Mukesh Kumar Dhillon, Soham Ray
pmc-13100293.description: Fruit flies (Diptera: Tephritidae) include nearly 200 economically important species, many of which are quarantine pests. Accurate identification is vital for pest management, but morphological diagnosis is often difficult for non-specialists due to similarities in diagnostic traits. DNA barcoding has become the gold standard, providing precise species identification using molecular markers.

pmc-13188424.title: Clinicopathological and molecular characterization of tumor-associated macrophages in sporadic and Xeroderma Pigmentosum-related cutaneous melanoma
pmc-13188424.creator: Asma Chikhaoui, Haifa Tounsi, Imen Nabouli, Mariem Jones, Rim Jenni, Malika Ben Ahmed, Chokri Naouali, Mohammed Zghal, Hamida Turki, Houda Yacoub-Youssef
pmc-13188424.description: BackgroundXeroderma pigmentosum (XP) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder, resulting from genetic defects in the nucleotide excision repair (NER) pathway. It predisposes individuals to skin cancers, including melanoma. The melanoma microenvironment is enriched with inflammatory mediators, particularly macrophages, which may serve as prognostic biomarkers or therapeutic targets.

pmc-13256844.title: A Giant Exophytic Gastric GIST Mimicking Ovarian Cancer: A Diagnostic Pitfall on CT and [18F]FDG PET/CT
pmc-13256844.creator: Sang Jun Byun, Sun-Jae Lee, Byungwook Choi
pmc-13256844.description: A 66-year-old woman was referred for evaluation of a large pelvic mass suspected to be ovarian cancer. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) revealed a giant multiseptated cystic pelvic mass with enhancing solid components; although its superior aspect closely abutted the gastric serosa, its predominant pelvic location raised concern for an adnexal malignancy.

pmc-13404041.description: BackgroundPeripheral arterial disease often affects the lower extremities, is frequently bilateral, and typically involves multiple leg segments. The ability to convert a conventional retrograde access to antegrade access would thus be valuable.
